Subject: Question on accelerator promo credits -> committed Dedicated conversion

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Two follow-ups from our side as we map internal budgets and the Launchlane cohort schedule:

1) If a cohort team uses sandbox / accelerator promo credits (the 50k trial bundle) and then converts to a Dedicated reserved pool under our customer account, can those promo credits be applied as a discount against the first month of committed capacity, or do they expire on conversion?

2) Are credits transferable across sub-accounts (we have a program-managed umbrella account + per-team sub-accounts)? We want to avoid forcing startups to claim credits on a sandbox that blocks conversion later.

Practical asks: could you share the commercial/ops flow (who signs the conversion addendum, what the invoice path looks like, and any notes on tax/accounting treatment)? We have counsel who will want the language if credits are to be grandfathered.

S — happy to set a short call if easier.

Cheers,

Subject: Re: Question on accelerator promo credits -> committed Dedicated conversion

Hi Kate — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, then operational details below.

TL;DR: We can usually allow cohort promo credits to offset the first invoice when converting to Dedicated, but it depends on how the credits were issued (promo vs. escrowed grant) and the contract path you choose. Transfers between sub-accounts are possible when the umbrella account holds the credits and the conversion is performed by that umbrella owner.

Operational notes:
- Promo type: 
  • Escrowed/grant credits (program-managed) — easiest to port: we apply them as a credit note against the first committed invoice.
  • One-off promo coupons (claimed by an individual startup account) — need a manual ops move and an approval from Finance. We recommend umbrella issuance for cohort reliability.
- Conversion flow (high level):
  1) Program/umbrella requests conversion via the console (or we can trigger via HubSpot).
  2) Sales (Ben) prepares a Dedicated quote that references the promo credit line item.
  3) Legal signs a short SOW/addendum if needed (calls out credit application and effective date).
  4) Finance applies a credit note to the first invoice; any remainder follows normal billing.
- Timing: allow 5–7 business days for credits to be mapped and the first invoice to be adjusted.
- Tax/accounting: we issue a credit note; please have your accounting team confirm local treatment (we mark it as a promotional credit in our ledger).

Ben / Marissa — can you confirm if the attached sample quote (I asked for a quick carve) can include a dedicated-line item for "cohort credit application" so legal/docs can reference it? Also flag any GOTCHAs on umbrella -> sub-account moves.

If it's easier, I'm free tomorrow morning for a 20-min call with Kate + her counsel.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Partnerships Lead | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com

Thanks Sofia — adding commercial detail and attaching a draft quote.

Key commercial options for Launchlane cohorts:
- Option A (Grandfather credits): umbrella account holds escrowed cohort credits; on conversion we apply remaining credit as a one-time invoice write-down for month 1. No special discount beyond credit application.
- Option B (Conversion discount): cohort credits converted into a time-limited discount applied across the first N billing cycles (requires finance approval and a minor amendment to our standard T&C).
- Option C (No-port): credits expire at conversion; programs issue a separate Managed Conversion Grant (rare).

Recommendation: Option A for predictability. It keeps accounting simple and avoids amending T&Cs. If you need a phased discount (Option B) we can scope a pilot and bake it into the quote.
